kicker: Extra! Extra! Week 1 is in the ground
headline: The Goon Gulch Express Is Robbed. Gopher Gold Rides Off With Every Strongbox.
deck: Twelve outfits boarded Tuesday. By Sunday night one gang had all the money, the defending champ was face down in the dining car, and one passenger never woke up.
hero_caption: The Goon Gulch Express crossing Dry Creek Trestle, as sketched by our correspondent from behind a large rock.

chapters.head: All Aboard the Goon Gulch Express
text: The Express pulled out of the station Tuesday morning with twelve outfits aboard and a strongbox bolted to the floor of every car. The timetable promised six days to the coast. The timetable lied.

Some gangs boarded with dynamite and a plan. John J boarded with seven roster moves and a hunch. Roshan boarded late, sprinted down the platform Sunday night and bought three tickets in three minutes. And Sagar boarded with a pillow, a newspaper and no intention of moving a muscle until the train hit the Pacific.
By the time the smoke cleared, the sheriff had nailed four posters to the depot wall.

chapters.head: The Wanted Board at the Depot
chapters.sub: Posted by order of the commissioner's office.

chapters.head: The Holdup at Dry Creek Trestle
chapters.caption: The strongbox, as recovered. Empty.
text: Six gunfights broke out between the cars. The biggest upset happened in the dining car, where the defending champion sat down to a steak and stood up with a hole in his badge: Parth's outfit pinned Thug Life to the tablecloth by a single category.
Elsewhere the robberies went to plan. Gopher Gold blew the safe in the baggage car and took everything, including the safe.

chapters.head: Gunfire in the Last Two Cars
chapters.caption: Saturday night, the caboose. Witnesses report a great deal of shouting.
text: Most holdups are decided before the train reaches the bridge. Four of these were still being argued on the roof of the caboose when the weekend came.

chapters.head: The Undertaker's Ledger
chapters.caption: The undertaker, reached for comment, asked to be paid in advance.
text: The undertaker worked a double shift. Jalen Williams went down on the last day of the trip and is laid out in Parth's sick car. Cooper Flagg, the priciest horse at the spring auction, is in Keshav's stable with a question mark nailed to the stall door. Stephen Curry is riding in John J's infirmary wagon.
Worst of all, Zero Fox Given rolled into Monday with two men the undertaker has already measured sitting in the starting lineup, boots on, eyes closed.

chapters.head: The Posse Rides Out
chapters.caption: The posse, departing Monday with the assayer's report and a bad map.
text: The posse saddled up Monday with the assayer's report in one hand and the odds in the other. Gopher Gold leads the chase, but the assayer ranks their claim only ninth in the territory, which is exactly how pyrite looks right before somebody bites it.

White Mambas, the old prospector with no moves and a losing record, is sitting on the richest vein in the hills and refuses to tell anyone. Zero Fox Given's claim is a hole in the ground with a tumbleweed in it.

chapters.head: Overheard at the Saloon
chapters.sub: Heard at the Silver Goon, where every manager was spotted at least once.

mvp.title: Sheriff
mvp.line: Robbed every car on the train in a single week and left a receipt. Sabonis did the heavy lifting and most of the rebounding.
mvp.reward: A tin star, two ponies, and the deed to a gold claim nobody has checked for rattlesnakes

dud.title: Dead Weight
dud.line: Slept in the caboose from the first whistle to the last. Has not filed one claim with the land office.
dud.reward: One mule with a limp, a sack of beans, and a free exorcism from the traveling tent preacher

luckiest.title: Horse Thief
luckiest.line: Rode a mule in the Derby and won by a length. Somebody check his saddlebags. And his sleeves.
luckiest.reward: A mail-order bride from Boston who has never seen a horse, and a one-way ticket on the next stagecoach out

robbed.title: Bushwhacked
robbed.line: Outdrew most of the gunslingers aboard, then caught one in the back from the Sheriff on the way to the exit.
robbed.reward: A new hat with fewer holes, and a sympathy pie from the widow who runs the boarding house

web.l.39751.t.5|web.l.39751.t.8.text: Suggs held the engine Friday. MONSTARS took it Saturday and pulled the whistle. Sunday, Scottie Barnes emptied both six-shooters at the boiler and missed every shot. The train coasted to a stop in a dead tie.

web.l.39751.t.7|web.l.39751.t.10.text: White Mambas sent Jamal Murray sprinting along the roof of the train on the weekend. He caught up just as Nova Knicks stepped off at the station with the bags.

web.l.39751.t.1|web.l.39751.t.12.text: theInfamous was hanging off the back of the caboose by Friday and clawed back one car. Adam Silver Dez Nuts had already uncoupled it.

web.l.39751.t.2|web.l.39751.t.11.text: Acinonyx already had the strongbox. On Sunday Luka walked back through every car and robbed the passengers too.

zingers.web.l.39751.t.1: Made more moves than anyone aboard. Darius Acuff Jr. took more shots than the whole O.K. Corral.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.2: Plays cards like a man with a derringer in his boot. Vučević started once and contributed about as much as a scarecrow in a duster.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.3: Paying rent on two infirmary cots for men who haven't seen daylight all season. The boarding house loves him.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.4: Struck gold and is already building the saloon. Sabonis shot like the hoop was a water trough.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.5: Two moves all week, same as the town drunk, and the same result: a tie with the hitching post.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.6: Cut De'Anthony Melton after one cold night. Jason picked him up, got a big night, and ran him out of town too.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.7: His waiver strategy is a man firing a scattergun at a barn and calling whatever he hits a plan.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.8: Paid thoroughbred money for a horse who spent half the trip in the barn. Still dragged the wagon to a tie.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.9: The champ's badge is already tarnished, and Kon Knueppel has yet to leave the infirmary cot.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.10: Sat on the porch with a rifle across his lap and never got up. Josh Giddey rode drag all week, eating everybody's dust.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.11: The piano player has made more roster moves, and the piano player is a piano.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.12: A decent card player at a table full of drunks. Enjoy the pot. The sober ones show up eventually.

sign_off: Next week the Gazette goes undercover. Spy Edition, Monday morning.
